items.body: You might think that finding a phone under $200 is an impossible task now that we live in a world where RAM prices are driving costs higher and higher. But the Samsung Galaxy A16 fits the bill and is the sixth best-selling phone on Amazon. It’s not the only Android device available for such a bargain though, so we were wondering what other phones like it would our readers would pick. Instead of leaving things totally open-ended, we presented a few choices and asked you for any alternatives. Our suggestions included the update to the original with the Samsung Galaxy A17, the Moto G Stylus (2025), the Moto G Power (2025), the Google Pixel 10a, and the Samsung Galaxy S25 FE.

items.title: Gemini Notebook’s creative flow update lets you fine-tune slides and videos before committing
items.summary: You can now tweak Gemini Notebook’s Slide Decks and Video Overviews before they’re made.
items.body: Credit: Adamya Sharma / Android Authority TL;DR Gemini Notebook is giving users more control over Slide Deck and Video Overview outputs. Users will now be walked through the creative flow, allowing them to steer the content toward their desired results. It will be a gradual rollout and may take up to 15 days for visibility. Having trouble getting Gemini Notebook to produce the Slide Decks and Video Overview you have envisioned in your head? Google is rolling out an update that will allow you to have more say in what the AI generates. If you haven’t already seen this functionality, then it will arrive for you soon. Google recently announced that it will add “co-creation” capabilities to Video Overviews and Slide Decks in Gemini Notebook. At the time, the company said that this functionality would arrive over the upcoming week, but didn’t offer an exact date. According to a new Workspace blog , the rollout started on October 16 for Workspace users and Google is taking a gradual approach to the release. The firm warns that it could take up to 15 days for feature visibility.

items.body: دوري روشن يقتفي أثر الكبار أصبح دوري روشن السعودي على موعد مع التاريخ، بعدما بات قريبًا من السير على خطى الدوريات الأوروبية الكبرى. وأعلنت قنوات "ثمانية"، الناقلة للدوري السعودي، أن مباريات البطولة سيتم إذاعتها بتقنية البث الفائق "4K" بدءًا من الجولة الحادية عشرة التي تنطلق غدًا الخميس. وأوضحت "ثمانية" أن تلك الخاصية ستتوفر لأول مرة في تاريخ الكرة السعودية، وستكون مُتاحة بشكل حصري للعملاء المشتركين في التطبيق الخاص بالقناة. في المقابل، ستواصل القناة إذاعة مباريات دوري روشن السعودي بشكل مجاني فضائيًا ورقميًا لغير المشتركين في التطبيق، على أن يكون ذلك بالجودة القياسية "SD". تحديثات ترفع سقف تجربة المشاهدة، ابتداءً من الجولة 11✨ إليك أهم ما تحتاج معرفته حول التغييرات في تجربة مشاهدة البطولات السعودية pic.twitter.com/aiBqNDxdWo — رياضة ثمانية (@thmanyahsports) October 21, 2026 كما كشفت القنوات السعودية عن بعض المزايا الخاصة بالمشتركين في التطبيق، على غرار الإعادة أثناء البث المباشر، والتغيير بين المعلقين وصوت الملعب، والتنقل بين أحداث المباراة. يُذكر أن تقنية البث الفائق "4K" يتم استخدامها في نقل بعض مباريات كرة القدم العالمية، على غرار الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، وبعض المباريات الكبرى في الدوري الإسباني والألماني ودوري أبطال أوروبا.

items.body: سقوط متكرر في ليلة أوروبية للنسيان، واصل مانشستر يونايتد سقوطه الحر في دوري أبطال أوروبا، بعدما تلقى هزيمة ثقيلة أمام كومو الإيطالي بنتيجة أربعة أهداف مقابل هدف، ضمن منافسات الدور التمهيدي للبطولة. الهزيمة لم تكن مجرد تعثر عابر، بل دخلت سجلات النادي كواحدة من أسوأ لياليه القارية، فوفقاً لما كشفته شبكة "سكواكا" العالمية لإحصائيات كرة القدم، فإن هذه هي المرة الرابعة في تاريخ مشاركات مانشستر يونايتد بدوري الأبطال التي يستقبل فيها أربعة أهداف أو أكثر ويخرج خاسراً. بدأ هذا السجل الأسود مبكراً في عام 1994، عندما سقط الشياطين الحمر برباعية نظيفة أمام برشلونة في كامب نو، في واحدة من أشهر هزائم جيل السير أليكس فيرجسون في بداياته الأوروبية. وتكرر الكابوس بعد ما يقارب ثلاثة عقود، وتحديداً في عام 2023 الذي شهد انهياراً دفاعياً غير مسبوق، فخسر الفريق بنتيجة 4-3 أمام بايرن ميونخ في أليانز أرينا، قبل أن يخسر بنفس النتيجة 4-3 بعد أسابيع قليلة أمام إف سي كوبنهاغن في الدنمارك، في نسخة كانت الأسوأ لليونايتد في تاريخه الحديث بدوري الأبطال. وجاءت الطامة الكبرى اليوم في عام 2026، أمام كومو، الفريق الذي لا يملك أي إرث أوروبي، ليتلقى يونايتد الرباعية الرابعة في تاريخه بنتيجة 4-1، ويؤكد أن أزمة الفريق لم تعد فنية فقط، بل أصبحت أزمة هوية وهيبة ضاعت في ليالي الأبطال. items.title: Honor Roll: Highlights & Records Achieved by the ‘Glee’ Cast on Hot 100, Billboard 200 & Other Charts
items.summary: The TV favorites tallied 207 Hot 100 hits, the most among non-solo acts.
items.body: Glee’s voices are set to soar again , Disney+ and Hulu announced on Wednesday (Oct. 21), after the streaming services gave co-creator Ryan Murphy a series order. The original Glee aired for six seasons, from 2009 to 2015, on Fox. In addition to its TV run, the series achieved notable highlights — and set records — on Billboard ’s charts. Related The ‘Glee’ Reboot Is Officially in the Works The cast, largely at Glee ’s start focusing on the high school-set show’s core show choir, New Directions, followed a unique strategy to achieve 207 entries on the Billboard Hot 100 — still the most among non-soloists. Multiple songs billed to the Glee Cast were released, on 20th Century Fox/Columbia Records, to accompany each new episode. Parlaying that onscreen reach, between May 2010 and March 2012, the act logged 15 weeks each with five debuts; four weeks each with six; and two weeks each with seven. Even with 173 of the Glee Cast’s 207 Hot 100 hits having spent one week each on the chart, its songs have sold 48.4 million downloads in the United States, according to Luminate — and drawn 4.5 billion official U.S. streams. items.title: Samsung Good Lock’s Quick Share alternative is failing to share files with iPhones
items.summary: Samsung’s Good Lock file transfer tool hit a wall, but a fix is on the way.
items.body: Credit: Ryan Haines / Android Authority TL;DR Galaxy users are reporting an issue with the Good Lock module Dropship When attempting to share a file, users are greeted with an error message. Samsung has confirmed that it is working on an update that will be released in November. Before Quick Share started receiving AirDrop support , there was Samsung’s Dropship solution. This Good Lock module allowed Samsung users to send up to 5GB worth of files per day to other devices, including iPhones. While primarily restricted to users in South Korea, users outside of the area have been able to sideload it. Dropship has now run into a bug that’s breaking its functionality. If you’ve been having trouble with Dropship, you aren’t the only one. Users are reporting that the Good Lock module is failing to send files to Apple’s handsets. One affected user claims that sending photo files is failing on six out of seven iPhones. When attempting to share a file, the user reportedly receives a message that says, “The coordinates you entered are incorrect, or the item has expired.”

items.title: Growing Up And Growing Old: How Country Music Addresses The Senior Years
items.summary: From Willie Nelson to George Strait to Taylor Swift, country musicians reflect on the passage of time.
items.body: When the Nashville Songwriters Hall of Fame holds its 2026 induction on Oct. 26, the honorees will include people whose songs are willing to show their age. Lee Thomas Miller co-wrote Trace Adkins’ “You’re Gonna Miss This,” in which an older repairman passes wisdom about the kids growing up to a flustered young mother. Bruce Channel co-authored John Conlee’s “As Long As I’m Rockin’ With You,” a 1984 ballad with a protagonist who’s come to accept his future rockin’-chair years after finding his soul mate. Singer-songwriter Shawn Camp fashioned an entire album, The Ghost of Sis Draper , around the semi-fictitious treatment of a real-life fiddler from an older generation that he met as a kid, building it primarily around songs penned with Guy Clark, some of them while Clark was in his later years. Their work helped make possible missions such as Perseverance and Europa Clipper as well as the future SkyFall and MoonFall missions. NASA/JPL-Caltech Interstellar probes. Lunar drones. Helicopters on Mars. When a group of Caltech graduate students and enthusiasts began conducting rocket-propulsion tests in Pasadena’s Arroyo Seco on Oct. 31, 1936, they had no idea that their work marked the inception of the Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Ninety years later, the lab, now managed by Caltech for NASA, isn’t only celebrating the long line of historic firsts accomplished here; it’s paving the way for many to come. Initially a contractor for the U.S. Army, JPL launched America’s first satellite, Explorer 1 in 1958. But rather than just orbiting Earth like the Soviet Union’s Sputnik, Explorer 1 became the first spacecraft to conduct science, thanks to an onboard Geiger counter that discovered the protective radiation belts encircling Earth. items.title: Google Chrome is done warning you about insecure websites after the fact
items.summary: The browser will now give you a heads-up before you visit an insecure website.
items.body: TL;DR Google is enabling Chrome’s “Always Use Secure Connections” setting for all users by default. Chrome will now warn users before connecting to insecure HTTP websites, giving them a chance to back out. Chrome won’t repeatedly warn users about approved HTTP sites, and Google says most users are unlikely to encounter these warnings anyway. An optional Chrome toggle that was first introduced back in 2022 is now being automatically enabled for everyone. Last year, Google announced its intention to make Chrome much safer for everyone , saying it would do so by prioritizing secure HTTPS connections when browsing the web and by warning users about websites still using the older HTTP protocol. Fast-forward to now, and Google is making good on that promise. The tech giant just confirmed that Chrome’s “Always Use Secure Connections” setting, which was enabled for users enrolled in Chrome’s Enhanced Protection mode of Safe Browsing earlier this year, has now become a standard part of the browsing experience.

items.title: Silicon-carbon batteries have changed the game — Apple and Samsung need to catch up
items.summary: 5,000mAh batteries are starting to feel increasingly small.
items.body: Credit: Robert Triggs / Android Authority Smartphone battery capacity is undergoing a revolution at the moment, thanks to increasingly mainstream silicon-carbon battery technology found in high-end handsets. Even the notoriously slow Samsung has adopted it in its latest Galaxy Z Fold 8 series . What started out as a reasonably modest boost to 6,000 mAh capacities has quickly reached 8,000 mAh and even 10,000 mAh models, almost doubling battery capacity potential in just a few short years. I’ve had the new OPPO Find X10 Pro Max in my pocket for the past few weeks, itself sporting an 8,000mAh Si-C cell. Though I should note that global models ship with a slightly reduced 7,150mAh split-cell design. OPPO claims that both models are sufficient for two days of typical use, and I’ve put my handset through our testing wringer to find out just how much longer it can endure compared to rival flagships.

items.title: Forget custom ROMs, you can now run iOS on Android phones
items.summary: Not using emulation or a sandboxed environment. The real deal!
items.body: Credit: GitHub / ios-sweet TL;DR Some developers have figured out a way to run iOS on Android phones. The process involves spoofing an iPhone X’s device drivers and running a custom version of the iPhone’s XNU kernel. Many of the components don’t work, but we’re seeing efforts to make them usable, one by one. Most popular Android skins now tend to copy iOS in terms of aesthetics. But what about real, actual iOS running on Android devices? I thought I was dreaming when I first heard claims that developers were porting iOS to Android devices. But over the last couple of days, I’ve seen countless reports of Apple’s proprietary operating system booting on a range of Android devices. It’s part of a new movement called “Hackios,” inspired by the iconic Hackintosh, which runs macOS on non-Apple hardware. The idea comes from an enthusiast’s GitHub project called “ iow-sweet ,” which replaces Android’s stock Linux kernel with XNU, Apple’s custom kernel for iPhones and iPads. A kernel is the core program of any operating system that dictates how hardware interacts with the software running on it. Here’s a detailed explainer on kernels if you’d like to read one.

items.body: TL;DR Android 17 QPR 3 Beta 2 finally lets you lock Quick Settings connectivity tiles. The feature prevents connectivity tiles from being toggled without unlocking the phone. It can prevent thieves from disabling connectivity features on a stolen phone, making it harder to track. Google has been working on introducing a useful new security feature in Android 17: the ability to prevent Quick Settings tiles from being toggled without unlocking the phone. We first spotted this feature back in June and then again a few months ago , but it wasn’t actually available to users either time. Now, Google is finally flipping the switch and letting users try it out on their devices. items.body: TL;DR Google Chrome is getting three new Enhanced Safe Browsing Protection features. It can share the webpages you visit with Safe Browsing servers to protect you from a broader range of scams. It can also share your clipboard content with Google’s servers to protect against social engineering scams like ClickFix. Google introduced Enhanced Protection in Chrome over half a decade ago. Since then, the company has added several new tools to identify increasingly sophisticated online threats and protect Chrome users from them. Now, Google is introducing three new features in Enhanced Safe Browsing Protection to combat web scams and further protect users. Google Chrome now takes a two-tiered approach to site safety warnings, displaying either a suspicious website pop-up or a full-screen dangerous site warning. When a Chrome user navigates to a website displaying known deceptive patterns, Chrome will show a new suspicious website pop-up informing the user that the site might not be safe.
